Container.Name: censarr
Container.Overview:
Adds a second audio track, "Censored - English", to shows and films from Plex or Jellyfin (and Sonarr, if you use it), with the profanity muted. One file, one extra track: the original audio is untouched and stays the default, and the censored one is picked from the audio menu in Plex or Jellyfin.
Runs on the CPU as it comes. With an NVIDIA GPU and the Nvidia Driver plugin, add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters (Advanced View). With no NVIDIA GPU, change Repository to ghcr.io/geoguy89/censarr:latest-cpu for a much smaller download.
Container.Changes: ### 1.1.0 - Renamed from Cleanarr to Cens-arr. The image is now ghcr.io/geoguy89/censarr; the old cleanarr name keeps getting updates, and settings, history and tracks already censored carry over unchanged. ### 1.0.0 - First public release.
Container.Requires: Plex or Jellyfin (Sonarr optional, for shows), with the media mounted at the paths it reports. An NVIDIA GPU and Ollama are optional.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Settings, the job database and the cached transcripts.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: The CONTAINER PATH must be what your library reports. Sonarr and Plex in containers usually report /data/media/..., so /data is right for them. Cens-arr opens those paths unchanged - there is no path rewriting.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: NVIDIA only: the GPU used to transcribe. 'all', or a GPU UUID from nvidia-smi -L. Needs --runtime=nvidia in Extra Parameters.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES
Config.Description: NVIDIA only: what the container may use the driver for.
